n: How do I set up the office printer?
k: printer print ricoh copier ip address install driver windows mac setup
a:
Windows: download the PCL 6 driver (Windows 10), then Control Panel → Devices and Printers → Add Printer → Add Local Printer → Create New Port (TCP/IP) → enter IP 10.200.16.30 → name it, don't share it, and point to the downloaded driver.
Mac: File → Print → Add Printer → IP tab → enter the printer's IP.
Printing is black and white only, so set your print settings to B&W or it won't print.

n: What do I need to submit a new listing to the TC team?
k: new listing submit tc transaction coordinator photos rocket lister ticket to sell requirements documents go live marketing order
a:
Before the TC team orders photos or starts marketing, upload to the TC team folder: signed MLS Input Form, Monsoon tax records, CMA, signed Exclusive Right to Sell Listing Agreement, Seller's Estimated Net Sheet, seller contact info, target go-live / photo date, and any special photo or marketing notes.
Allow 24 hours after submission. Confirm the live date and photo readiness with the seller, and tell the TC team right away if dates change (Rocket Lister orders run about $200–$300 per listing).

n: How do I save teammates' contacts on my phone?

n: Who do I contact for assumable loans?

a: The team is a preferred Assumable Network Agent. Lender: David Krushinsky, Reasy Financial — 602-695-7575, david@reasyfinancial.com. n: What do I turn in after an open house?

a: Turn the completed Open House checklist in to the Operations Manager the Monday after the open house. Use the paper feedback form only when the app can't be used; photo/scan it and submit it with the checklist, and enter guest contact info into CINC. The kit list, feedback form, recap template and sign-up half-sheet are all on the Open House page.
